validation_scope: Sparse reviewed Pune central pixels. Chennai was also inspected for regression selection, not a blind test. Coverage percentages are not accuracy.

road_validation.scope: Eight previously inspected development/regression crops; no independent blind-test claim
road_validation.reason: Road-only fine-tunes failed the Chennai non-regression check; keep original five-class weights. This is bounded post-processing, not new training.

input_requirements: 0.6 m B/G/R/NIR TIFF, or unchanged band/crop from the three locally registered products; companion bands recovered only after pixel/grid verification.
warning: Experimental: road quality remains poor. Short supported gap repair gives only a small improvement, not reliable highway extraction. Fine-tuned road candidates were rejected for cross-city regression. Overall accuracy decreased by less than 0.06 percentage point on the inspected crops. More correctly traced road labels are needed.
